title: Compliance Schedule: Recent Paid-Out Principal and Limit Review Timing on the Personal Sender Account
content:
For a limit review request on a Personal Sender Account, recent sending is the USD principal paid out on the customer's personal transfers in the 6 months before the request date, an entry dated on the same calendar day 6 months earlier or before it no longer counting, summed over every Bank Deposit payout sent, every Cash Pickup payout made and every Mobile Wallet credit sent in that window.

## Schedule

| Recent sending (USD paid out in the 6 months) | Business days added to the counted decision window |
|---|---|
| 20000.00 or more | 2 |
| at least 8000.00 but below 20000.00 | 1 |
| below 8000.00 | 0 |

When recent sending is 20000.00 USD or more, 2 business days are added to the counted decision window of the request; when it is at least 8000.00 USD but below 20000.00 USD, 1 business day is added; when it is below 8000.00 USD, nothing is added for recent sending.

## Where the figures come from

The amounts are the USD amounts of the payout entries in the ledgers of the customer's transfers: the payout sent entries of Bank Deposit transfers, the payout made entries of Cash Pickup transfers and the credit sent entries of Mobile Wallet transfers, each dated inside the 6 months. Payments, fees, refunds and other ledger entries are not part of the sum.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Bank Deposit payouts sent | Cash Pickup payouts made | Mobile Wallet credits sent | Recent sending | Business days added |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 499.99 | 7999.99 | 0 |
| 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 500.00 | 8000.00 | 1 |
| 12000.00 | 6000.00 | 1999.99 | 19999.99 | 1 |
| 12000.00 | 6000.00 | 2000.00 | 20000.00 | 2 |

All amounts are hypothetical USD figures dated inside the 6 months before the request date.
